name: Market Intel
tagline: Packaged market research and opportunity discovery for consulting-style deliverables

product.name: Market Intel
product.description: Recurring market scans, competitor briefs, and GO/NO-GO evaluations for client-facing research encargos.

presets.taskTemplate: Scan demand for {{niche}} — competitors, pricing anchors, and 3 monetizable angles with evidence links.
presets.deliverableHint: Market report in docs/research/ with TAM/SAM sketch, competitor table, and ranked opportunities.

presets.taskTemplate: Deep-dive drilldown on the top opportunity from the last scan — validate demand, risks, and a 2-week validation plan.
presets.deliverableHint: Drilldown memo in docs/research/ plus CEO decision brief in docs/ceo/.

presets.taskTemplate: Evaluate {{idea}} for a consulting client — Munger pre-mortem, unit economics sketch, GO/NO-GO recommendation.
presets.deliverableHint: GO/NO-GO pack across docs/research/, docs/critic/, docs/cfo/ with a single client-ready summary.

presets.taskTemplate: Recommend pricing for a research/report offering — tiers, packaging, and invoice-ready price points.
presets.deliverableHint: Pricing model in docs/cfo/ and sales one-pager in docs/sales/.

presets.taskTemplate: Weekly pipeline review for market-intel engagements — open leads, deliverables shipped, revenue follow-ups.
presets.deliverableHint: Ops summary in docs/operations/ with next actions per active client thread.

profileSeed.summary: Market Intel — research-as-a-service vertical for opportunity scans and validation reports.
profileSeed.valueProposition: Ship client-ready market reports in days, not weeks — structured agent workflows with audit trail.
profileSeed.targetAudience: Founders, agencies, and corporate innovation teams buying ad-hoc market research.
profileSeed.problemStatement: Manual research is slow and inconsistent; generic ChatGPT output lacks citations and GO/NO-GO rigor.
profileSeed.monetizationHypothesis: Repeat scans + drilldown upsell after first delivered encargo.
profileSeed.nextAction: Run opportunity-discovery preset, deliver report link to client, record revenue on the encargo.

defaultNextAction: Apply Market Intel pack — run opportunity-discovery from Office recepción or Estrategia department.
